title: ATP Protocol
description: Schema for Agent Task Protocol protocol definition files. Schema version: 0.1.0. Grace period for new required fields: 30 days (warn not fail). See SPEC.md ## Schema Versioning.

classification.description: public=generic pattern, ATP repo. private=deployment-specific, instance only. template=public pattern with placeholder values, ATP repo templates/.

review_authority.description: Role identifier who approves PRs for this protocol (e.g. deployment-owner, primary-agent)

triggers.description: Keyword/pattern triggers for string-match fallback classification

semantic_summary.description: 2-3 sentence dense description optimized for embedding quality. Must be distinctive and trigger-aware. Used as the primary RAG retrieval surface.

preload_size_class.description: Estimated total token cost of all declared vars + docs. xs=<500, sm=<2k, md=<10k, lg=<50k, xl=>50k.

priority.description: Conflict resolution priority. Higher wins when multiple protocols match. Default 50.

specificity_score.description: Explicit specificity override for conflict resolution step 3. Higher = more specific. Takes precedence over computed trigger-length specificity.

oneOf.description: Simple escalation rule text (severity defaults to warn)

tier.description: Which execution tier this protocol belongs to. execution (default): run by sub-agents with bounded context. orchestration: run by the Captain/primary agent for routing decisions only.

checkpoint_policy.description: Required for execution-tier protocols. Defines how partial execution is handled to ensure infrastructure is never left in an unknown intermediate state.

on_partial.description: write-handoff-artifact: stop and record partial state for recovery. commit-and-stop: commit changes made so far, then stop. rollback-and-stop: undo all changes, then stop.

clean_state_definition.description: What constitutes a safe stopping point for this protocol. Be specific.

rollback.description: Command or steps to undo partial execution. 'none' if no rollback is applicable.

tool_allowlist.description: Minimal viable tool set for sub-agents running this protocol. Declared here for reference; enforced via context bundle.

routing.description: Orchestration routing table. Maps task sub-types to execution protocols and context bundle recipes. Only valid when tier=orchestration.

task_pattern.description: Human-readable sub-task description used to match incoming task requests.

execution_protocol.description: Protocol id of the execution-tier protocol to delegate to.

var_ids.description: Var ids to include in the context bundle sent to the sub-agent.

model_class.description: Model cost/capability tier to use when spawning the sub-agent.
